facts.P1_fx_receipts: Yes, but service providers must sell 70% of export receipts within 30 days.
facts.P2_fcy_account: Yes: foreign-currency accounts can receive transfers from abroad, with limits.
facts.P3_local_gateways: Local gateways not confirmed yet; see the services listed above.
facts.L1_registration: Register an individual enterprise through the EDBM one-stop shop; fees not confirmed.
facts.L2_tax_id: NIF from the DGI, reportedly free in 2–3 days via NIFONLINE.
facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: Under MGA 400m turnover, the synthetic tax is 5%, possibly cut by 70%.
facts.L4_vat_gst: 20% VAT from MGA 400 million turnover; exports are 0%.
facts.L5_data_protection: A data protection law exists, but it isn't applied in practice yet.
facts.L6_consumer_ecommerce: Online consumer protection law exists; refund rules not confirmed yet.
facts.L7_incentives: The reducible 5% synthetic tax is the main simplification.

watch_out.text: Freelancers billing abroad may have to convert 70% of earnings.
